scope: Development delivery prototype; supplied original evidence, not retrieval E2E
stop_rules: fallback or unknown outcome or wrong raw model: stop after current request
non-400 provider error or 3 known 400s: stop; no retries or continuation
development_gates: full entity-set exact rate no worse than shared-value baseline
wrong complete negative delivery no worse; invalid output never safe delivery
at least one strict gain in full set exact, wrong complete negatives or safe partial coverage
typed valid format >=95%; combined recorded tokens <=1.6x baseline
complete registered batch, one raw primary model, all source slices and request messages verified
any claimed quality gain must persist on the predeclared unambiguous core
sensitivity_reason: SST corpus-family/variant granularity and char-level subset/global dataset scope are disputed before answer calls; retain all eight primary rows and inspect six-case core.
limits: aliases and self-reported states do not prove semantic role or exhaustive coverage
no expert calibrated semantic accuracy; no automatic production promotion
new shared entity-value baseline is not historical long-form F1

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
